interface.name: tuna_osk_input_v1
interface.description: Available only on the compositor-supervised IBus connection. Text events are ordered with input-method-v2 focus changes on that same connection. The serial is the input-method-v2 done count. Stale events and replies must be discarded, never retargeted to a new field.

request.name: unhandled

description.summary: one Unicode keysym declined by the engine

request.description: The compositor synthesizes one press/release without re-entering the input-method grab. The serial must still identify the active field.
